# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 59 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 47 | Coptic

---

## Saying 59

Jesus said: "Look upon the Living One while you are alive, so that you will not die and seek to see him and be unable to see."

---

**Translator's Notes (EMET):**

- **ⲡⲉⲧⲟⲛϧ** / *petonkh*: "the Living One" — a title; echoes "I am the Living One" of Revelation 1:18
- The double negation ("will not die and seek") is preserved from the Coptic syntax
- "See him" — the pronoun is masculine, referring to the Living One
- The saying presents an urgency of present encounter with the Living One as opposed to post-mortem seeking
- Parallel structure: living → see / dead → unable to see
